verdict.rationale: OCI documents platform-wide developer surfaces. The CLI is said to provide the same core functionality as the Console. The APIs are described as uniform REST/HTTPS, and each SDK ships with documentation. This implies broad, consistent coverage beyond flagship services. However, no evidence shows per-service API/CLI reference pages, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec at the common candidate paths. missing for 10: explicit evidence of complete per-service API and CLI reference docs, evidence that docs are consistent across niche services, independent or hands-on corroboration of reference quality.
